subject.title: [Bug] Webchat avatar endpoint /avatar/{agentId} returns 404 even with valid IDENTITY.md avatar

question: Should unresolved local avatars keep returning a generic 404 from direct `/avatar/{agentId}` while safe reasons are exposed through metadata/UI surfaces, or should the raw endpoint expose more specific 4xx errors such as 413 for oversized files?
rationale: The current code already carries safe `avatarReason` metadata, but changing the raw image endpoint changes the local file-serving disclosure boundary and user-facing HTTP contract.

options.title: Keep raw 404, improve safe UI diagnostics
options.body: Preserve the current file-serving boundary and only improve metadata, settings, docs, and webchat-facing feedback for oversized or missing avatars.

options.title: Expose specific raw HTTP errors
options.body: Return explicit 4xx statuses from `/avatar/{agentId}` for known policy failures, after defining exactly which reasons are safe to disclose.

options.title: Close after fork PR cleanup
options.body: If maintainers consider current metadata, docs, and settings feedback sufficient, close this after closing or rejecting the open conflicting fork PR.

recommendation.title: Keep raw 404, improve safe UI diagnostics
recommendation.body: Preserve the current file-serving boundary and only improve metadata, settings, docs, and webchat-facing feedback for oversized or missing avatars.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest merged-history signal across avatar support, shared avatar policy, and Control UI local-file avatar hardening.
